pages.title: Intimidation
pages.text: Press Alt+L to use Intimidation and briefly halt nearby mobs. You can rebind the key in Controls. A successful cast enters cooldown even if nothing is nearby.

pages.title: Tiers and Maids
pages.text: More cumulative maid kills raise Intimidation's tier, range, and duration while shortening its cooldown. Your maids become more fearful when affected, and their current daily events may end. A Doting Maid behaves for a while after the effect ends.

pages.title: Tiers 1–2
pages.text: Tiers run from 1 to 5 and unlock through your total TLM maid kills. Tier 1 is available with zero kills.$(br2)Tier 1: 0 kills; 16-block radius; 8 seconds; 15-minute cooldown.$(br2)Tier 2: 1 kill; 24-block radius; 10 seconds; 12-minute cooldown.

pages.title: Tiers 3–4
pages.text: Tier 3: 10 kills; 32-block radius; 12 seconds; 8-minute cooldown.$(br2)Tier 4: 100 kills; 48-block radius; 15 seconds; 3-minute cooldown.

pages.title: Tier 5
pages.text: Tier 5: 1,000 kills; 64-block radius; 20 seconds; 1-minute cooldown.$(br2)Zero kills is the requirement for Tier 1, not a Tier 0.
